description: Lists the signed-in player's Support conversations, newest activity first, 10 a page: each one's subject (the first line the player wrote), opening message, status (sent, open, replied, on hold or resolved), latest message once someone has replied, message count and unread replies, with its link. Read it before send_feedback to find a report already sent. count is the total; pass offset for the next page. Requires mcp:read.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

llm_model.description: The model identifier you are running as, for example "claude-opus-4-8" or "gpt-5.2". Pass "unknown" if you are not certain. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

offset.description: How many conversations to skip, for the next page.

name: list_my_feedback
title: List my feedback conversations
